youtubeTitle: The scooter that got someone to their first job interview is doing more for India's growth story ...
caption:
The scooter that got someone to their first job interview is doing more for India's growth story than most headlines give it credit for.

Progress isn't only the big, visible bets - it's also the small, unglamorous tools that let ordinary people show up and try. A 20-year story is built from a lot of those, not just the ones that make the news.
